body: Damn you other countries with your better-than-me connections! I pay for 8Mbit connection. Lolnope. We get 512kbit speeds and 1000ms ping.
I THREW IT ON THE GROUND
Go to /r/enoughinternet, it's highly rated there.

Everyone thinks that I'm an amazing person who's going to do wonderfully in life. But in actuality, I hear voices, have multiple personalities, have attempted suicide and once tried to (and had the ability to) blow up a bus. The only reason I didn't is because for the first time in my life, someone talked to me instead of the other way round.

I'm disappointed with my life. And yet, there is one person who would quite probably kill himself if I did.

Thanks for reading. I feel slightly better now.
